lines.x: The French National Assembly unanimously rejected the government's proposed budget, raising concerns regarding the country's 5.1% budget deficit.
Alstom cut its adjusted EBIT margin outlook to about 1% from 6.5% previously, citing execution issues with Coradia Max, triggering a share slide of up to 28% and prompting an overhaul plan.
The International Energy Agency reported that the global gas market could remain tight well into next year as Europe enters the heating season with historically low gas storage levels.
Forvia posted stronger revenue in the third quarter of 2026.
